## Code Review

This pull request removes the obsolete cross-mode data-dir tracking to prevent write contention between independent Desktop and TUI processes sharing a single SQLite WAL. It also refactors the launcher helper script to ensure dry-runs do not mutate state (such as creating directories, copying auth, or prewarming databases) and adds tests to verify these behaviors. Feedback was provided to add a guard clause to the new `directory_is_empty` test helper to prevent it from scanning the root directory if the argument is empty or unset.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces authority-aware full-loop lifecycle gates and repository authority profiles across various agent workflows and documentation. It distinguishes between aidevops, maintained apps, and external upstream contributions, ensuring that external contributions stop at a verified ready PR without merging, while maintained repositories perform audited local base branch synchronization. A new regression test script (`test-full-loop-authority-profiles.sh`) is added to enforce these rules. Feedback on the test script suggests adding a file existence check and using safe parameter expansion in the `require_text` function to prevent potential unbound variable errors under `set -u`.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a helper function `_setup_opencode_binary_is_ephemeral` to identify and skip temporary or ephemeral OpenCode binary paths during setup, and adds a test suite to validate this behavior. The review feedback highlights a potential pattern-matching issue when `TMPDIR` has a trailing slash, which would result in double slashes (e.g., `/tmp//*`) and cause valid paths to fail to match. The reviewer suggests stripping trailing slashes from the temporary root variable in both implementation files and adding a test case to cover this scenario.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a preflight validation bypass mechanism (`_GHRP_PREFLIGHT_ONLY`) to handle cases where the native `gh` CLI rejects invalid option combinations (specifically `--slurp` combined with `--jq` or `--template`) before making any HTTP requests. By extracting the validation logic into `_ghrp_validate_prepare` and flagging preflight-only execution, the shim avoids misclassifying these invalid invocations as transport attempts. Corresponding tests have been added to verify this behavior. There are no review comments, and I have no additional feedback to provide.
